central_pp_note: Vy, offset<=200m, +/-20ms around geometric n*PP arrivals; windows can include other phases, not a pure-mode decomposition. Matched ratio, worst full-time central Vy error, and conservative full-surface/all-time/both-component peak relative to each window peak are reported. The last criterion asks for all five windows to exceed the global boundary error100x.
bands: all x0..1400; inner offset<=400; outer offset>400; central offset<=200
physical_definition: extended layered minus extended homogeneous; all interface-induced response including mode conversion and multiples, not individual pure phases
error_definition: candidate minus extended layered; includes PML entrance, PML interior, outer boundary and numerical growth, not solely outer boundary
primary_criterion: full-time/all-physical-top error/physical reflected response <=0.01 for weighted L2 and peak; reject strong or monotonic late PML growth. Echo windows and components additionally reported.
limitations: 1 s, central source30Hz, p5/h5; finite-domain numerical control not analytical exact solution; no long-time stability proof
